ruleZh: 景区列表保存唯一实体；文化遗产页只保存 spotSlug、遗产级别、入选理由和专题排序，通过引用展示同一详情页，不复制景区正文。平遥的双林寺、镇国寺可先作为 relatedComponents，后续内容足够时再升级为独立 spot。
ruleEn: Keep one canonical attraction entity. The heritage page stores only spotSlug, designation, heritage rationale and thematic ranking, linking to the same detail page rather than duplicating text. Shuanglin and Zhenguo Temples may begin as relatedComponents and become standalone spots when enough content is available.
